news.api_views.approved_log(request, *args, **kwargs)[source]

Log an approved article. Called after an editor approves one.

Parameters:

request – The API request, with the article as JSON

Returns:

201 once logged, 400 without a title, or 403 if the user is not an editor

Return type:

rest_framework.response.Response

news.api_views.article_detail(request, *args, **kwargs)[source]

Retrieve, update or delete one article.

PUT and DELETE are allowed for editors and for the journalist who wrote the article. Only editors can approve with "approved": true.

Parameters:

  • request – The API request (token authenticated)

  • pk (int) – The article’s ID

Returns:

200 with the article, 204 after deleting, 400 if the data is invalid, 403 if the user is not allowed, or 404 if not found

Return type:

rest_framework.response.Response

news.api_views.article_list(request, *args, **kwargs)[source]

List approved articles, or create a new article.

GET returns all approved articles. POST creates an article for the logged-in journalist. New articles wait for an editor’s approval.

Parameters:

request – The API request (token authenticated)

Returns:

200 with the articles, 201 with the new article, 400 if the data is invalid, or 403 if the user is not allowed

Return type:

rest_framework.response.Response

news.utils.approve_article(article, editor)[source]

Approve an article, email its subscribers and log it to the API.

Both the editor’s approve page and the API’s PUT call this function.

Parameters:

  • article (Article) – The article to approve

  • editor (User) – The editor approving it
